items.description: A receipt kind is not in the allowlist.
A receipt was present after NON_CLOSABLE.
Outcome basis uses a forbidden receipt kind (e.g. ENV_ATTEST).
Signature does not match sha256(canonical_event) for v1.
Signing public_key does not match bound public_key.
More than one distinct canonical event exists for the same event identity scope.
No resultset is present; verifier cannot conclude.
No resultset, but a terminal signal was present (attempt to conclude).
Resultset present but evidence is missing.
Evidence is not qualified; requires stronger evidence or NON_CLOSABLE.
Effective evidence rank is below required.
Outcome basis conflicts with effective evidence.
NON_CLOSABLE receipt indicates action cannot be closed with available evidence.
